name: HolyArrs
cost: Free (AGPL-3.0). A commercial licence is offered for closed products
works_with: Docker on amd64, arm64 and armv7. Plex, Jellyfin and Emby; qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, rTorrent, SABnzbd and NZBGet
short: One small self-hosted app that replaces Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr, Prowlarr and Seerr for your shows, movies and music.
what: HolyArrs is a single self-hosted app for a home media server. You browse like a streaming app, ask for a title, and it searches your sources, picks a release by your rules, sends it to your downloader and files it in your library. The image is about 15 MB and it can move your settings over from the six apps it replaces.
who: People who already run a home media server with Plex, Jellyfin or Emby and a downloader, and want one login in place of six. Skip it if you want it to download by itself: it connects to your downloader and does not replace it yet.
needs: A local disk for the config folder. A network share will not work for it
Media and download folders, owned by the user whose PUID and PGID you set
A downloader such as qBittorrent or SABnzbd, and a source such as a Torznab or Newznab indexer

steps.title: Save the compose file
steps.text: Save this as `docker-compose.yml` in a new folder on a local disk, and change the paths to your own.
steps.code:
name: holyarrs
services:
  holyarrs:
    image: holyarrs/holyarrs:latest
    container_name: holyarrs
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - /your/local/path:/config
      - /path/to/movies:/movies #optional
      - /path/to/tv:/tv #optional
      - /path/to/music:/music #optional
      - /path/to/downloads:/downloads #optional
    ports:
      - 6262:6262
    restart: unless-stopped

steps.title: Find the right user and group IDs
steps.text: `PUID` and `PGID` must match the user that owns your media folders.

steps.title: Make the owner account straight away
steps.text: Open `http://your-server:6262`. A short setup asks for your folders, a downloader and a source.

steps.title: Optional: bring your old setup
steps.text: Open Settings > Move from other apps, add each old app's address and API key or a backup zip, run Try it, then Move. It only reads the old apps, and you can undo a move later.

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.text: Every line says OK, WARN or FAIL, and each problem says how to fix it.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Open Explore, hover a title to play its trailer, and ask for a whole show or one season.

watch: There is no default password. Until you make the owner account, whoever opens HolyArrs first becomes the owner.
Do not forward port 6262 on your router. The README says to use a VPN such as Tailscale or a reverse proxy with HTTPS.
Stored passwords and keys are encrypted with `holyarrs.key` in your config folder. Backups do not include it, so keep a copy somewhere else (Settings > Backups > Download key kit).
Every install talks to a metadata server the author runs for titles, artwork and charts.
Moving from old apps leaves keys, passwords, custom formats, tags and history behind.
Not in 1.0 yet: a built-in downloader, AI or MCP features, phone and TV apps, and music in Explore.
